name: Banjo Recompiled
summary: Official Banjo Recompiled runtimes in portable mode with your normalized Banjo-Kazooie (USA) 1.0 ROM preloaded.

release_rules.notes: Stable v-prefixed releases. Linux x64 has been published as .tar.gz (v1.0.2) and .zip (v1.0.1); both formats are accepted.

linux.description: Official Linux x86-64 build (not the Flatpak or ARM64 builds).

inputs.label: Banjo-Kazooie (USA) 1.0 N64 ROM
inputs.notes: .n64/.v64 dumps are byte-swapped to .z64 before checking. The runtime stores the accepted ROM as bk.n64.us.1.0.z64 beside the executable in portable mode.

source_checks.description: The runtime still supports the US 1.0 game ID
The runtime still expects the same ROM content hash

operations.description: Preload the ROM where portable mode looks for it
Enable the runtime's official portable mode

operations.text:
{name} {version} portable package.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder, then run {launch_command}.
portable.txt keeps saves and settings in this folder. Your normalized US 1.0 ROM is preloaded as bk.n64.us.1.0.z64.
Official upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Packaging checks file structure only. Record startup or gameplay results separately for this exact download.

linux.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.sh.

windows.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd.

saves: portable.txt makes the runtime store saves and settings beside the executable. Carry them forward when replacing the folder.

linux: x86-64 Linux with a Vulkan driver (runtime requirement published upstream)

limitations: Windows packages have not been launched on native Windows.
Only the USA 1.0 ROM is accepted by this definition.

verified_releases.evidence: Manual 2026-10-11 package: Linux frontend started with the preloaded ROM; Windows assembled, not launched (RomM 12964 / 12967).

history: 2026-10-11: first packages assembled with outputs/package-native-ports.py after byte-swapping the ROM by hand. This definition automates the same steps.
